brief: Adam's service tool bag, exactly the bag that stands on the chair in the second reference image: a soft olive-green canvas tool bag with a wide open top, rounded ends, brown leather trim, two front pockets, a long olive canvas shoulder strap with a metal buckle; tools stick out of the open top and the front pockets: a screwdriver with a red handle, pliers with orange grips and an adjustable steel wrench. Recoloured locally to the brown leather of the S01 bag (M5-04).
